description: Satellite fixture rendered on the EXACT Google Static Maps zoom-20/scale-2 grid.

provenance.imagery_source: Esri World Imagery (ArcGIS Online MapServer export)
provenance.attribution: Imagery © Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
provenance.why: No Google Maps API key available. Rendered on the identical Web Mercator bbox that Google Static Maps z20/scale2/640x640 covers, so calibration performed on this fixture is valid unchanged for live Google imagery.
provenance.usage_scope: Case-study submission only. Not cleared for unrestricted public redistribution.

fixture_image_transform.provenance: Identity: fixture was rendered directly on the source-map grid (same centre, same bbox, same 1280x1280 raster).
